description: Code Scaffold Tactile Kinetic Component Matrix: 86 high-fidelity React micro-interaction primitives and agentic UI surfaces.

components.title: Text morph
components.description: Text that changes the way it should: shared letters slide over, new ones rise out of a blur, the width eases.

components.title: Status button
components.description: Save, Saving, Saved: the spinner opens in, the check draws itself, errors shake, and the label morphs between them.

components.title: Number roll
components.description: Numbers that change like an odometer: every digit rolls in the direction the number moved.

components.title: Pricing toggle
components.description: Monthly or yearly: the thumb slides with a little give, and every price on the page rolls to its new amount.

components.title: Waitlist field
components.description: An email field that becomes its own answer: the button stretches across it, then settles as "You’re on the list · #1,248".

components.title: Code input
components.description: The six boxes, done properly: digits rise in, a paste cascades, a wrong code shakes and clears, the right one becomes a pill with a check.

components.title: Steps form
components.description: A multi-step form in one card that changes shape: steps slide in from the way you’re going, checks shake and explain, and Create turns into what comes next.

components.title: Date range picker
components.description: A range is one liquid band: it follows your pointer between days, presets flow it to their span, and the dates morph as it moves.

components.title: Morphing nav
components.description: One dropdown that follows you along the menu, gliding and resizing to each item’s content.

components.title: Feature tabs
components.description: One panel, many features: the line slides between tabs, fills as autoplay runs, and the panel eases to each.

components.title: Scroll story
components.description: A how-it-works section that tells itself as you scroll: steps light up at the middle, a rail fills, and one card reshapes into each step’s picture.

components.title: Stats band
components.description: Numbers that arrive when you do: precision strokes draw themselves, then each figure rolls up from zero in turn.

components.title: Announcement pill
components.description: "New: …" above your headline that opens into the news: the pill itself grows into a changelog card.

components.title: Testimonials
components.description: One quote, chosen by its people: faces step forward, the words cross-fade through a blur, a ring keeps time.

components.title: FAQ accordion
components.description: Questions on precision strokes that open like they mean it: the answer eases to its height, the plus folds into a minus.

components.title: Logo marquee
components.description: A quiet strip of logos that notices you: it eases to a stop on hover and the logo you point at stays bright.

components.title: Expanding gallery
components.description: An image opens from its exact place in the grid, becomes a spacious viewer, and finds its way back.

components.title: Card deck
components.description: A tactile stack that fans out, follows your hand, and deals the next card with a measured flick.

components.title: Workflow canvas
components.description: Connected steps you can move, inspect and follow as work flows through them.

components.title: Image compare
components.description: Two images, one precise divide. Drag to reveal what changed, then let the handle settle.

components.title: Magnifying dock
components.description: A dock that makes room for the tool you reach for, then opens it in place.

components.title: Hold to confirm
components.description: A deliberate action, held for a moment: the ring fills, the label changes, and confirmation settles into a check.

components.title: Precision dial
components.description: A small instrument for getting a value just right. Drag to tune; hold Shift for the finer details.

components.title: Swipe actions
components.description: A row that makes room for its next step. Swipe to reveal, then choose what happens.

components.title: Radial menu
components.description: One starting point, a few ways forward. Commands unfold into a small clockwise constellation.

components.title: Drop zone
components.description: A drop zone whose border is a membrane: it reaches for the file, holds it, swallows it and passes it through to its row.

components.title: Wheel picker
components.description: Drums you can fling: each column is a real cylinder that decays onto a row, with a lens in full colour over the middle.

components.title: Morphing chart
components.description: Bars, line and area as one set of marks: bars condense into beads, a thread is strung through them, the fill pours down. Drag the switch to scrub it.

components.title: Range ruler
components.description: Two precision needles across a graduated scale. Thumbs glide without layout thrash and repel each other on contact.

components.title: Ratio balancer
components.description: A multi-segment allocation track. Drag dividers to rebalance constrained percentages with lockable pins.

components.title: Split pane
components.description: A desktop-grade resizable dual panel. Zero-lag drag, rubber-band spring limits, and double-click preset snapping.

components.title: Command palette
components.description: ⌘K that grows out of the search pill: fuzzy search, nested lists, and commands that run in place.

components.title: Toast stack
components.description: Notifications that stack, fan out on hover, follow a promise in one toast, and swipe away.

components.title: Live activity
components.description: One pill for whatever is happening now: it updates in place, tap it and it grows into a panel, done blurs into a check.

components.title: Live cursors
components.description: Other people’s cursors gliding over the same page: names that turn into speech bubbles, click ripples, and selections that follow them around.

components.title: Live map
components.description: The world as dots, lighting up where things happen: pings ripple, the light lingers, and one card follows the newest event from city to city.

components.title: Theme toggle
components.description: The sun sets into a moon, and the new theme spreads from the button in a circle.

components.title: Pricing calculator
components.description: Drag to your size and watch the price roll, the plan morph and, at the top, “Let’s talk”.

components.title: Comparison table
components.description: Plans side by side, with a column that glides to the plan under your pointer and prices that roll.

components.title: Onboarding checklist
components.description: The first five things, ticked off in place: a ring that fills, checks that draw, and a finish worth seeing.

components.title: Sortable list
components.description: Drag to reorder and everything moves: rows slide out of the way, the dropped one settles, every rank rolls, and presets re-sort the lot.

components.title: Changelog timeline
components.description: What shipped, drawn as you read: a rail that fills, dots that light, filters that fold the rest away.

components.title: Changelog trace
components.description: What shipped, routed like a circuit: the line steps aside between releases, and a bead runs down it as you read.

components.title: Changelog scrubber
components.description: Your release history on a ruler you scrub: drag the playhead, or press play and watch the product ship.

components.title: Cookie banner
components.description: Asks once, plainly, then folds into a small cookie button in the corner that grows back into the preferences.

components.title: Newsletter footer
components.description: A footer that’s still alive: a signup that becomes its own confirmation, drawn link underlines and your name in outline.

components.title: Prompt composer
components.description: The input that starts it all: grows as you type, takes files, and turns Send into Stop while answering.

components.title: Agent composer
components.description: The taller composer for agent surfaces: branch, folder and context on a tab above, permissions and model as pills that grow into their lists.

components.title: Mentions and commands
components.description: Type @ to pull in context or / for a command. The menu grows from the caret and your text becomes a chip.

components.title: Attachment chip
components.description: A file on its way into a prompt: uploading, being read, ready or failed.

components.title: Mode switcher
components.description: Fast, Thinking, Research: a segmented switch with a sliding pill and locked paid modes.

components.title: Model picker
components.description: The model pill in your composer grows into the menu: what each model is for, speed, smarts and thinking effort.

components.title: Voice input
components.description: Dictate a prompt: a waveform from your real mic level, a timer, then transcribing.

components.title: Voice note
components.description: A voice message you can scrub and read along with: the waveform fills, the time rolls, and the transcript highlights each word as it’s said.

components.title: Thinking indicator
components.description: Four quiet loaders for the gap before the first token, with a label, a rolling timer and a finish that draws itself.

components.title: Thinking trace
components.description: An expandable record of what an agent did: steps, reasoning, search or tool calls.

components.title: Tool call
components.description: One tool invocation from arguments to result: preparing, running, done, failed or denied.

components.title: Clarifying question
components.description: The agent pauses to ask. Pick with a click or a number key, or type your own; it folds into a one-line receipt.

components.title: Approval card
components.description: The agent asks before it acts: what it wants to do, the details, Approve or Deny.

components.title: Plan
components.description: An agent’s checklist that ticks itself off: pending, in progress, done, skipped or failed.

components.title: Web research
components.description: Watch the agent search: the query types in, page icons stack up as it reads, then it folds into a trail of searches and the pages each one found.

components.title: Command output
components.description: A command the agent runs: the log streams in, folds away on success, and stays open on failure.

components.title: Task progress
components.description: For work that takes minutes: phases, a live timer, stats, cancel, and the result when it’s done.

components.title: Task log
components.description: What the agent did, task by task, as it does it: steps arrive on a precision trail, files sit in chips, titles turn past tense.

components.title: Streaming answer
components.description: An answer as it arrives, with inline citations, actions, sources and follow-ups.

components.title: Code block
components.description: Code in an answer: highlighted as it streams, copy and wrap, long files folded, and an optional Apply.

components.title: Citation
components.description: An inline numbered source that previews the site, title and snippet on hover or focus.

components.title: Response versions
components.description: Step between regenerated answers with "2 / 3", and regenerate without losing the old ones.

components.title: Selection actions
components.description: Select text and a pill appears under it. Pick an action or describe an edit, and the rewrite streams in place.

components.title: Inline rewrite
components.description: Drag a dial and the paragraph rewrites itself in place: shared words glide, the rest blur out and rise in.

components.title: Diff review
components.description: Accept or reject what the AI changed, word by word for prose or line by line for code.

components.title: Action receipts
components.description: What the agent actually did, one quiet line each, with Undo while a ring drains. Several stack into one.

components.title: Error and limit states
components.description: Calm, specific notices for failed answers, being offline, rate limits and chats that grow too long.

components.title: Usage meter
components.description: Credits, messages or context left: quiet when there’s plenty, clear before it runs out.

components.title: Usage limits
components.description: What an agent has left: the context window split by what fills it, and each plan limit with its share and a live reset countdown.

components.title: Jump to latest
components.description: A chat that follows the answer as it streams, lets go the moment you scroll up, and brings you back.

components.title: Edit and resend
components.description: Fix a sent message where it sits. The bubble grows into an editor, then folds back and branches the reply.

components.title: Chat history
components.description: Past chats grouped by day, searchable, with titles that write themselves, rename in place and delete with Undo.

components.title: Earnings chart
components.description: A bar chart that changes instead of redrawing: bars glide between periods, the scale and the total roll, a readout follows the pointer.

components.title: Steps chart
components.description: A week against a daily goal: days that make it fill in, a wave runs the way you step through the weeks, the totals roll.

components.title: Revenue chart
components.description: This year as an area, last year behind it; point at a month and the header becomes the readout, switch the measure and the lines reshape.

components.title: Area chart
components.description: Several series stacked, overlapping or as shares: every band morphs between layouts, and the tiles are the legend, the switches and the readout.

components.title: Combo chart
components.description: Every day as a bar and the trend as a line on one scale: point at a day and the header becomes its readout while the line’s dot pings where it lands.

components.title: Stage bars
components.description: A funnel you can read at a glance: every stage as a bar against the first, the drop-off between them, and widths that ease when the period changes.

components.title: Activity rings
components.description: Three daily goals as concentric rings beside a tight legend, with the week underneath: pick a day and the rings sweep to it.

components.title: Agent playback
components.description: Your AI product working, hands-off and on a loop: the hero demo built from the real components.
